sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行现场直播，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Caitlin Dickerson.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的凯特琳·迪克森。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the vote on the health care bill is off, for now.
sentences.zh: 今天，医疗保健法案的投票暂时取消了。

sentences.en: Why a small group of senators blocked the Republicans' biggest legislation since Trump's election.
sentences.zh: 为什么一小群参议员阻止了自特朗普当选以来共和党最重要的立法。

sentences.en: And after the shooting of Philando Castile, we see there was a four-year-old girl sitting in the back seat.
sentences.zh: 在菲兰多·卡斯蒂尔被枪杀后，我们发现后座上还坐着一个四岁的小女孩。

sentences.en: What happens to the family members who witness police shootings?
sentences.zh: 目睹警察枪击事件的家属会怎么样？

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 6 月 28 日，星期三。

sentences.en: I had hoped, as you know, that we could have gotten to the floor this week, but we're not quite there.
sentences.zh: 正如你所知，我本希望我们能在本周提交表决，但我们还没完全准备好。

sentences.en: But I think we've got a really good chance of getting there.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们有很大的机会做到这一点。

sentences.en: It'll just take us a little bit longer.
sentences.zh: 只是会多花我们一点时间。

sentences.en: Hi, Jennifer Steinhauer.
sentences.zh: 嗨，詹妮弗·斯坦豪尔。

sentences.en: Hey, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: We meet again.
sentences.zh: 我们又见面了。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, so big news.
sentences.zh: 所以，有个大新闻。

sentences.en: The Senate is pushing back its vote.
sentences.zh: 参议院正在推迟投票。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生什么事了？

sentences.en: So, I mean, the long and short of it is that they could not get the votes needed by Republicans.
sentences.zh: 所以，简而言之就是他们无法获得共和党所需的票数。

sentences.en: They could only afford to lose two Republican senators, and they have far more than that from both ends of the spectrum
sentences.zh: 他们只能承受失去两名共和党参议员的代价，而来自各个派别的反对人数远不止于此

sentences.en: that simply were not willing to vote to even proceed, even to begin to debate the bill.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不愿意投票通过，甚至不愿意开始辩论这项法案。

sentences.en: So, rather than take a failed vote, Senator Mitch McConnell, the majority leader, decided to postpone the whole exercise until after the July 4th recess.
sentences.zh: 因此，多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔参议员决定推迟整个议程，直到 7 月 4 日休会之后，而不是进行一次注定失败的投票。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Far more.
sentences.zh: 多得多。

sentences.en: So, so who are the Republican senators who have said they won't move forward, and where are they from?
sentences.zh: 那么，哪些共和党参议员表示不会推进该法案？他们来自哪里？

sentences.en: Well, the truth is there's a large universe of Republican senators who had problems with the bill.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实是，对该法案有异议的共和党参议员范围很广。

sentences.en: Some of them weren't even vocal about it, but we know that they were out there.
sentences.zh: 他们有些人甚至没有公开表态，但我们知道他们确实存在。

sentences.en: Whether you're talking about Rob Portman from Ohio, you had Senator Ted Cruz of Texas.
sentences.zh: 无论你是说来自俄亥俄州的罗布·波特曼，还是来自得克萨斯州的泰德·克鲁兹参议员。

sentences.en: This current draft doesn't get the job done.
sentences.zh: 目前这份草案根本达不到要求。

sentences.en: Senator Rand Paul of Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 来自肯塔基州的兰德·保罗参议员。

sentences.en: We're afraid that when we read the bill that it actually looks like a reiteration or a keeping of Obamacare.
sentences.zh: 我们担心，当我们阅读该法案时，它实际上看起来像是对奥巴马医改的重申或保留。

sentences.en: Lisa Murkowski from Alaska, who was very clear.
sentences.zh: 立场非常明确的来自阿拉斯加州的丽莎·穆尔科斯基。

sentences.en: Today, I don't have enough information.
sentences.zh: 今天，我没有足够的信息。

sentences.en: I don't have enough data in terms of the impact to my state to be able to vote in the affirmative.
sentences.zh: 就对我的州的潜在影响而言，我没有足够的数据来投赞成票。

sentences.en: You had Susan Collins from Maine.
sentences.zh: 还有来自缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯。

sentences.en: I have very serious concerns about the bill.
sentences.zh: 我对该法案有非常严重的担忧。

sentences.en: Now, you talk about states like Alaska and Maine that have smaller populations and very rural places.
sentences.zh: 现在，你谈到像阿拉斯加和缅因这样人口较少、非常偏远的州。

sentences.en: And when you have a very rural state, that's important because health care is less accessible and thus it's more expensive.
sentences.zh: 当你身处一个非常偏远的州时，这很重要，因为医疗保健的可及性较差，因此成本更高。

sentences.en: Also, if you want to focus on Maine, where Senator Susan Collins has been a fierce advocate for her state and a pretty vocal opponent of this bill,
sentences.zh: 此外，如果你把焦点放在缅因州，苏珊·柯林斯参议员一直是她所在州的坚定捍卫者，也是该法案相当直言不讳的反对者，

sentences.en: and in fact, someone who was on the tip of the spear in terms of leading to its demise for now, you're talking about a state.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她也是导致该法案目前流产的急先锋，你讨论的是这样一个州。

sentences.en: A state that has a lot of working class voters who would have lost some of their health insurance subsidy.
sentences.zh: 一个拥有大量工薪阶层选民的州，他们将失去部分医疗保险补贴。

sentences.en: You're talking about people, part-time workers who are struggling.
sentences.zh: 你谈论的是那些苦苦挣扎的人们、兼职工人。

sentences.en: You're talking about a state like many states, and I would include Alaska and I would include Ohio and I would include West Virginia,
sentences.zh: 你谈论的是这样一个州——就像许多州一样，我还要加上阿拉斯加、俄亥俄州和西弗吉尼亚州——

sentences.en: that have a high rate of opioid incidents where the mental health provisions and the Affordable Care Act were helping people work through addiction problems,
sentences.zh: 那里阿片类药物事件发生率很高，而《平价医疗法案》中的心理健康条款一直在帮助人们克服成瘾问题，

sentences.en: which, as you know, the opioid crisis is really just sweeping the country.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，阿片类药物危机确实正在席卷全国。

sentences.en: And you're talking about a place where people have small businesses, which have generally been opposed to the law,
sentences.zh: 你谈论的是一个人们拥有小型企业的地方，这些企业通常一直反对这项法律，

sentences.en: but I'm talking about little tiny businesses with two and three employees where you have entrepreneurs who were able to leave their jobs
sentences.zh: 但我说的是那些只有两三名员工的微型企业，那里的创业者能够离开他们的工作岗位，

sentences.en: because they were no longer, you know, kind of tethered to the insurance of their large employers
sentences.zh: 因为他们不再，你知道的，被大型雇主的保险所束缚，

sentences.en: and able to start these little businesses because they were able to buy health insurance.
sentences.zh: 并且能够购买医疗保险来创办这些小企业。

sentences.en: So Maine kind of has it all.
sentences.zh: 所以缅因州可以说是具备了所有这些特点。

sentences.en: Oh, and I forgot one other huge component, of course, is that Maine has one of the oldest populations in the country.
sentences.zh: 哦，我忘了一个极其重要的因素，当然，缅因州拥有全国最老龄化的人口之一。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: And the people who really get hammered in this bill are older, poor, working-class Americans who do not yet qualify for the Medicare program.
sentences.zh: 在这项法案中真正受到沉重打击的是那些年龄较大、贫困、尚未达到联邦医疗保险（Medicare）资格的美国工薪阶层。

sentences.en: They were looking at getting pretty hammered there.
sentences.zh: 他们面临着相当沉重的打击。

sentences.en: So if you look at those components, that's why Susan Collins was a pretty strong voice on this.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你看看这些因素，这就是为什么苏珊·柯林斯对此发出了强有力的声音。

sentences.en: Lee Umphrey is the CEO of the Harrington Family Health Center in Harrington, Maine.
sentences.zh: 李·安弗雷是缅因州哈林顿哈林顿家庭健康中心的首席执行官。

sentences.en: The Harrington Health Center is in the heart of down-east Maine.
sentences.zh: 哈林顿健康中心位于缅因州当尼斯特地区的中心地带。

sentences.en: Geographically, it's beautiful, the ocean, the blueberry barrens, but it's very isolated and it's very rural and there's no public transportation.
sentences.zh: 从地理上看，那里很美，有海洋、蓝莓荒原，但非常偏远，非常荒凉，没有公共交通。

sentences.en: There's hardly any employment opportunities, so people rely on seasonal work.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有什么就业机会，所以人们依赖季节性工作。

sentences.en: So a community health center really is an essential part of their life.
sentences.zh: 因此，社区健康中心确实是他们生活中不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: During the ACA, we enrolled 1,500 people into affordable health care plans.
sentences.zh: 在《平价医疗法案》实施期间，我们为 1,500 人办理了平价医疗保险计划。

sentences.en: And I met everybody who signed up for a plan, and most of them never had health care coverage before.
sentences.zh: 我见过了每一个注册该计划的人，他们大多数人以前从未拥有过医疗保险。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Sounds like a pretty large number.
sentences.zh: 听起来是个相当大的数字。

sentences.en: How does that compare to the entire city?
sentences.zh: 这与整个城镇相比如何？

sentences.en: I mean, is that almost everybody?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，几乎是所有人吗？

sentences.en: Well, it is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实如此。

sentences.en: Yes, and our service area is 17 communities, but our town of Harrington is only 1,000 people.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们的服务区域有 17 个社区，但我们哈林顿镇只有 1,000 人。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: So we reached out to the surrounding communities, and it was hard because it was such political opposition to the ACA and Obamacare, and our area is very politically conservative.
sentences.zh: 所以我们联系了周边社区，这很艰难，因为对《平价医疗法案》和奥巴马医改有着强烈的政治反对情绪，而且我们地区在政治上非常保守。

sentences.en: And so it was a real challenge trying to convince people that affordable health care made sense.
sentences.zh: 因此，试图说服人们平价医疗是有意义的，这是一个真正的挑战。

sentences.en: But once people started enrolling, I think word of mouth really spread.
sentences.zh: 但一旦人们开始注册，我认为口耳相传真的发挥了作用。

sentences.en: You know, it created a mindset for people that, you know, health care could be affordable, and it gave them peace of mind, too, that they could get care.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这为人们树立了一种观念，即医疗保健是可以负担得起的，这也让他们感到安心，知道自己能够获得治疗。

sentences.en: And again, a lot of these people, lobstermen, fishermen, work in the woods, blueberry barons, had never had health insurance before.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这些人中有很多是龙虾捕捞者、渔民、在树林里工作的人、蓝莓种植者，他们以前从未买过医疗保险。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: Tell me, I'm curious a little bit more about the patients you serve.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，我很好奇你所服务的患者的更多情况。

sentences.en: What are the most prominent health issues that they're dealing with?
sentences.zh: 他们正在处理的最突出的健康问题是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In our area, in Downey's, Maine, unfortunately, we are the leaders in every health category there is.
sentences.zh: 在我们地区，也就是缅因州当尼斯特，不幸的是，我们在所有的健康类别中都“名列前茅”。

sentences.en: We have the highest obesity rate, highest diabetes rate, highest early death rate, highest cancer rate.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有最高的肥胖率、最高的糖尿病率、最高的早逝率、最高的癌症率。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: People in our area, they've never had health insurance, so they never took care of themselves.
sentences.zh: 我们地区的人们以前从未拥有过医疗保险，所以他们从不照顾自己。

sentences.en: And so they have chronic conditions, multiple chronic conditions.
sentences.zh: 因此他们有慢性病，多种慢性病。

sentences.en: And, you know, one of the ways we overcame the politics of all of this was talking to them about all the patient protections within the ACA and why it was good for them to come in
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们克服所有这些政治阻力的方法之一，就是与他们谈论《平价医疗法案》中的所有患者保护措施，以及为什么来这里对他们有好处，

sentences.en: and didn't matter if they had a preexisting condition or had multiple health issues.
sentences.zh: 而且不管他们是否有既往病史或有多种健康问题，这都无关紧要。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think what it did is it gave them hope that they can become healthier and have an affordable coverage plan and then come in and have us provide the services they need.
sentences.zh: 我认为这样做带给他们希望，让他们相信自己可以变得更健康，拥有负担得起的保障计划，然后走进来让我们提供他们所需的服务。

sentences.en: And it's not just primary care but behavioral health.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是初级保健，还包括行为健康。

sentences.en: And we've had the opioid epidemic here, which is a tremendous issue, not only here in rural Maine,
sentences.zh: 我们这里爆发了阿片类药物流行病，这是一个极其严重的问题，不仅在缅因州农村地区，

sentences.en: but across the country and where everyone's concerned that the new bill being projected is just going to harm that effort to try to curb people's addiction probleMs.
sentences.zh: 而且在全国各地都是如此，每个人都担心正在规划中的新法案只会损害遏制人们成瘾问题的努力。

sentences.en: So in your view, Lee, I mean, you're seeing up close what the community looks like and the whole spectrum, really.
sentences.zh: 所以依你之见，李，我的意思是，你近距离看到了社区的面貌以及整个方方面面。

sentences.en: So do you think this fight over health care happening in Congress should be about fixing the Affordable Care Act, which it sounds like did a lot of good for people in your city,
sentences.zh: 那么你认为国会这场关于医疗保健的争斗，应该是关于修复《平价医疗法案》——听起来它为你们城市的居民做了很多好事——

sentences.en: or do you think it's about starting from scratch, creating something new that can be even better?
sentences.zh: 还是你认为这应该从零开始，创造出甚至更好的新事物？

sentences.en: I see it as evaluating what worked and how do we make it better.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是评估什么行之有效以及我们如何使其变得更好。

sentences.en: I see these people every day with these multiple chronic conditions, and they're so relieved, peace of mind, that they can get care and hopefully get better.
sentences.zh: 我每天都看到这些患有多种慢性病的患者，他们感到非常宽慰，内心也重获平静，因为他们能够得到治疗并有望好转。

sentences.en: And so I think the uncertainty now is bothering a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得现在的不确定性正在困扰着很多人。

sentences.en: So having insurance created a mindset and losing it is creating a real negative impact.
sentences.zh: 因此，拥有保险树立了一种心态，而失去它则会产生真正的负面影响。

sentences.en: They don't want to lose their existing coverage.
sentences.zh: 他们不想失去现有的保障。

sentences.en: And we're reassuring them that regardless of what happens, that they can still come in and we're going to provide the right kind of care.
sentences.zh: 我们正在向他们保证，无论发生什么，他们仍然可以来这里，我们将提供正确的护理。

sentences.en: But that uncertainty is kind of fueling more uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 但这种不确定性正在助长更多的不确定性。

sentences.en: Let's zoom out a little bit from Maine, Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗，让我们把视线稍微从缅因州拉远一点。

sentences.en: As you said, this is sort of a singular state, but what can the rest of the country take away from how Maine would be impacted by this health care bill
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这是一个有点特殊的州，但对于缅因州将如何受到这项医疗保健法案的影响，全国其他地方能从中汲取什么经验

sentences.en: or any other health care bill?
sentences.zh: 还是任何其他医疗保健法案？

sentences.en: I mean, what's the broader lesson from that state?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那个州能带给我们什么更广泛的教训？

sentences.en: Well, not every state has all of the components of Maine, obviously.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然并非每个州都具备缅因州的所有特点。

sentences.en: But every state has something that Maine has.
sentences.zh: 但每个州都有缅因州所拥有的某些东西。

sentences.en: A lot of old people, a lot of poor people, a lot of people who were previously uninsured who now have insurance under the Affordable Care Act.
sentences.zh: 很多老年人、很多穷人、很多以前没有保险但现在根据《平价医疗法案》拥有保险的人。

sentences.en: So every state has either enjoyed some benefit from the Affordable Care Act or have needs that are addressed with the expansion of access to health care.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个州要么从《平价医疗法案》中获得了某些好处，要么有通过扩大医疗服务可及性来解决的需求。

sentences.en: It's hard to take that back from people.
sentences.zh: 要把这些从人们手中夺走是很困难的。

sentences.en: And there are some Republicans not eager to do that in a rapid or large-scale manner.
sentences.zh: 有些共和党人并不急于以迅速或大规模的方式这样做。

sentences.en: And that has been the great difficulty for Republicans to grapple with.
sentences.zh: 这就是共和党人一直难以应对的巨大困境。

sentences.en: OK, Jennifer, thanks so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 好的，詹妮弗，非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我参加。

sentences.en: On Tuesday evening, President Trump invited all 52 Republican senators to the White House.
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，特朗普总统邀请了全部 52 名共和党参议员前往白宫。

sentences.en: This will be great if we get it done.
sentences.zh: 如果我们把它办成，那就太棒了。

sentences.en: And if we don't get it done, it's just going to be something that we're not going to like.
sentences.zh: 如果我们没办成，那也只是一个我们不会喜欢的结果。

sentences.en: And that's OK.
sentences.zh: 这也没关系。

sentences.en: And I understand that very well.
sentences.zh: 我非常理解这一点。

sentences.en: The president was photographed flanked by the senators who have been most vocal about their apprehensions over the bill, including Senator Susan Collins of Maine.
sentences.zh: 总统拍照时，站在他两旁的是那些对该法案表现出最多担忧的参议员，其中包括来自缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯参议员。

sentences.en: This president is the first president in our history who has had neither political nor military experience.
sentences.zh: 这位总统是我们历史上第一位既没有政治经验也没有军事经验的总统。

sentences.en: And thus, it has been a challenge to him to learn how to interact with Congress and how to push his agenda forward.
sentences.zh: 因此，学习如何与国会互动以及如何推动他的议程向前发展对他来说是一个挑战。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会当 DJ 的时候，你每天晚上都要带着 300 件你最珍贵的传家宝去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把 DJ 台变成了一个宛如充满 50 年前美丽工艺品的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在您最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，甚至无需输入信用卡，那会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报App，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: On July 6, 2016,
Philando Castile was shot by a police officer inside his car.
sentences.zh: 菲兰多·卡斯蒂利亚在车内被一名警察枪击。

sentences.en: The police led his girlfriend, who was in handcuffs, and her four-year-old daughter into the back of a police car.
sentences.zh: 警察将戴着手铐的女友和她四岁的女儿带到了警车后座上。

sentences.en: Last week, the video of that shooting was released for the first time.
sentences.zh: 上周，那场枪击事件的视频首次被公之于众。

sentences.en: Yamiche Alcindor, you covered that shooting for The Times.
sentences.zh: 雅米什·阿尔辛多，你曾为时报报道过那起枪击事件。

sentences.en: Walk us through that video.
sentences.zh: 请带我们了解一下那段视频。

sentences.en: The video shows Diamond Reynolds and her daughter moments after Philando Castile was shot.
sentences.zh: 视频显示的是菲兰多·卡斯蒂利亚中枪后不久的戴安娜·雷诺兹和她的女儿。

sentences.en: I can't believe they just did this.
sentences.zh: 我不敢相信他们竟然做了这种事。

sentences.en: I'm f***ing.
sentences.zh: 我他妈的。

sentences.en: And what you see is a young girl really comforting her mother, telling her not to scream, not to cry, and telling her that,
sentences.zh: 你可以看到一个小女孩在真正地安慰她的母亲，告诉她不要尖叫，不要哭泣，并告诉她，

sentences.en: I'm scared that you're going to get quote-unquote shooted.
sentences.zh: 我害怕你被所谓的小心枪击。

sentences.en: Eventually, her mom kind of regains herself after screaming and screaming and screaming and says, it's okay, I got this.
sentences.zh: 最终，她的妈妈在不断的尖叫之后恢复了一些理智，说，没关系，我能应付。

sentences.en: So you then see them kind of transitioning to coming to terms with what just happened.
sentences.zh: 所以你随后会看到他们开始过渡到接受刚刚发生的事情。

sentences.en: And at that point, the little girl is, was she four years old?
sentences.zh: 而在那个时候，那个小女孩，她当时四岁吗？

sentences.en: The little girl, I think, was four years old.
sentences.zh: 那个小女孩，我想，当时四岁。

sentences.en: So that video was made public after it was shown to jurors in a courtroom last week in the case against the police officer who shot Philando Castile.
sentences.zh: 所以这段视频是在上周针对枪杀菲兰多·卡斯蒂利亚的警官的法庭审判中向陪审员展示后才公之于众的。

sentences.en: Can you remind us about the case?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们回顾一下这起案件吗？

sentences.en: So Philando Castile was a young man who was driving with his girlfriend and her young daughter in the backseat.
sentences.zh: 菲兰多·卡斯蒂利亚当时是一个年轻男子，开车时后座载着他的女友和她年幼的女儿。

sentences.en: He was stopped for what the police are now saying was because he fit the description of some suspect that has yet to fully be described.
sentences.zh: 他被拦下，警察现在的说法是因为他符合某个尚未完全描述的嫌疑人的特征。

sentences.en: But the officer says that it's because he has a broken brake light.
sentences.zh: 但警官说是因为他的刹车灯坏了。

sentences.en: and has something wrong with his car.
sentences.zh: 并且他的车出了点问题。

sentences.en: Philando Castile was armed at the time and told the officer that he had a gun in the car.
sentences.zh: 菲兰多·卡斯蒂利亚当时持有武器，并告诉警官车里有一把枪。

sentences.en: And says several times, going for the gun, the officer used to get startled and shoots Philando.
sentences.zh: 并且多次说，去拿枪，警官以前会感到惊慌失措并向菲兰多开枪。

sentences.en: So essentially, this is a man who was driving with his girlfriend and her daughter in the car with a gun and was shot by police.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，这是一个带着女友和她女儿在车里、身上有枪的男人，却被警察枪杀。

sentences.en: And the officer was acquitted of all charges.
sentences.zh: 而这名警官被判所有罪名不成立。

sentences.en: And the officer, as in a lot of other cases, said that he feared for his life and that he smelled marijuana on Philando.
sentences.zh: 这名警官和许多其他案件一样，称他感到生命受到威胁，并且他在菲兰多身上闻到了大麻味。

sentences.en: And that's why he shot.
sentences.zh: 这就是他开枪的原因。

sentences.en: We should say Philando Castile's weapon, the gun that he had, he had that legally.
sentences.zh: 我们应该说明，菲兰多的武器，他带的那把枪，是合法持有的。

sentences.en: He was licensed to carry and also told the officer very clearly that he had the gun and that he was not going for it.
sentences.zh: 他有持枪证，并且非常清楚地告诉警官他有枪，而且他不会去拿枪。

sentences.en: But the officer said that he thought that because he smelled like marijuana and he was someone who could be reckless and smoke around a child, that he somehow feared for his life.
sentences.zh: 但警官说，他认为由于他身上有大麻味，而且他可能是那种会在孩子面前抽烟的鲁莽之人，所以他某种程度上感到生命受到威胁。

sentences.en: Emish, you've covered these shootings for years.
sentences.zh: 埃米什，你报道这些枪击事件已经好几年了。

sentences.en: And in a lot of them, you've stayed with the families.
sentences.zh: 在其中的许多案件中，你一直陪伴着这些家庭。

sentences.en: You've covered them for months, sometimes even for years.
sentences.zh: 你追踪报道了几个月，有时甚至几年。

sentences.en: So what happens to the children?
sentences.zh: 那么孩子们怎么样了？

sentences.en: What happens to kids like this little four-year-old girl?
sentences.zh: 像这个四岁小女孩这样的孩子会怎么样？

sentences.en: In Diamond Reynolds' daughter's case, she's watched a man that was her mom's boyfriend that she loved, that she was friends with, be murdered in front of her eyes
sentences.zh: 在戴安娜·雷诺兹女儿的案子里，她看着一个曾经是她妈妈男友、她所爱、她引以为友的男人在她的眼前被谋杀，

sentences.en: and then had to console her mother and step into that role as a four-year-old.
sentences.zh: 然后不得不去安慰她的母亲，并在四岁时承担起那个角色。

sentences.en: In a lot of these other cases, these kids are very much struggle with how to go on.
sentences.zh: 在许多其他案件中，这些孩子极力挣扎着不知该如何继续生活。

sentences.en: So Tamir Rice was a young man who was shot in Cleveland.
sentences.zh: 泰米尔·赖斯是一个在克利夫兰被枪杀的年轻人。

sentences.en: His sister lost like 50 pounds and could hardly go to school because he was so traumatized.
sentences.zh: 他的姐姐体重骤降了约50磅，几乎无法去上学，因为她受到了极大的创伤。

sentences.en: Oscar Grant is another young man who was shot in California.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡·格兰特是另一个在加利福尼亚被枪杀的年轻人。

sentences.en: Unarmed in the back by an officer who was convicted but then given a really light sentence.
sentences.zh: 在背后被一名被定罪但随后被判极轻刑罚的警察无端枪杀。

sentences.en: And his daughter ducks when she sees the police because she's terrified of them.
sentences.zh: 而他的女儿看到警察时会躲起来，因为她对他们感到极度恐惧。

sentences.en: To this day?
sentences.zh: 直到今天？

sentences.en: To this day.
sentences.zh: 直到今天。

sentences.en: So you have kids who are just completely terrified of the police.
sentences.zh: 所以有些孩子对警察完全充满了恐惧。

sentences.en: Then there are kids who really are going through the struggle of just missing the person.
sentences.zh: 还有一些孩子真正在经历着因思念逝者而带来的内心挣扎。

sentences.en: So in Eric Garner's case, his grandkids and his children had to watch him die over and over and over again because at the same time, while we have these videos
sentences.zh: 所以在埃里克·加纳的案子中，他的孙辈和孩子们不得不一遍又一遍地看着他死去，因为与此同时，当我们有这些视频

sentences.en: that are shining a light on a lot of these cases, these families have to watch these videos over and over again.
sentences.zh: 让许多此类案件大白于天下时，这些家庭却不得不一遍又一遍地观看这些视频。

sentences.en: So you have children watching their grandparents die over and over again.
sentences.zh: 所以你会看到孩子们一遍又一遍地看着他们的长辈死去。

sentences.en: And that in itself is also a sort of second victimization for a whole other generation.
sentences.zh: 这本身对整整一代人来说也是一种二次受害。

sentences.en: My son, he is 15 years old.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子，他15岁了。

sentences.en: He had to watch this as this was put all over
sentences.zh: 当这一切被广泛传播时，

sentences.en: the outlet.
sentences.zh: 他不得不观看。

sentences.en: Each time you write a story like this, you spend time with, of course, the families and the descendants, but you also talk to people who have a totally different view
sentences.zh: 每次你写这样一篇报道，你当然会花时间与家属和后代相处，但你也会与那些对警察涉嫌枪击事件持有

sentences.en: of police-involved shootings.
sentences.zh: 完全不同看法的人交谈。

sentences.en: Do you have a sense of how people who view this issue very differently take in that information, how they see it, what they think of it?
sentences.zh: 你是否知道那些对这个问题持有截然不同观点的人是如何吸收这些信息的，他们是如何看待的，他们对此有何看法？

sentences.en: For the most part, I mean, they see it almost as a lot of the juries see it.
sentences.zh: 大体上说，我的意思是，他们的看法几乎和许多陪审员的看法一样。

sentences.en: They see it from a very legal standpoint, that even if it's sad or it's tragic that these shootings have happened, and I think I've talked to many police officials
sentences.zh: 他们从非常法律的角度来看待此事，即使这些枪击事件的发生令人感到悲伤或悲惨，我想我曾与许多警务官员

sentences.en: and union officials who say, yeah, that's a real tragedy, but legally, what is happening here?
sentences.zh: 以及工会官员交谈过，他们说，是的，这是一场真正的悲剧，但从法律上讲，这里究竟发生了什么？

sentences.en: Legally, you have an officer who felt that he was in danger in some way and as a result had to take the action that his training told him he had to take.
sentences.zh: 从法律上讲，你有一名警察，他觉得自己在某种程度上处于危险之中，因此不得不采取他的培训告诉他必须采取的行动。

sentences.en: So I think that a lot of times I don't think that they see the actual videos that much differently.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为很多时候，我不认为他们对实际视频的看法有什么本质上的不同。

sentences.en: I think it's that they see the legal standards for what they are and as a result, they don't see an officer just as another citizen that's doing something
sentences.zh: 我认为是他们按照原样看待法律标准，因此，他们并不把警察看作是另一个可能在做可疑事情的普通公民。

sentences.en: that maybe is questionable.
sentences.zh: 可能是有问题的。

sentences.en: They see an officer of the law who's been entrusted to be able to make possibly fatal mistakes without having them be criminal.
sentences.zh: 他们看到的是一位受委托能够犯下可能致命的错误而不必承担刑事责任的执法人员。

sentences.en: So a lot of union officials often say, like, an officer can make a mistake, but should he go to jail for that mistake?
sentences.zh: 因此，许多工会官员经常说，比如，一名警察可能会犯错，但难道他应该为这个错误入狱吗？

sentences.en: It's very difficult for police officers to know what they're dealing with, especially in split-second situations.
sentences.zh: 对警察来说，要弄清楚他们面对的是什么非常困难，尤其是在千钧一发的时刻。

sentences.en: These are split-second decisions that need to be made to prevent violence to themselves, to others,
sentences.zh: 这些是需要在一瞬间做出的决定，以防止对自己、他人造成暴力伤害，

sentences.en: and possibly even the suspects.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能包括嫌疑人。

sentences.en: What is it like for the families that you know to watch the acquittals that come afterward?
sentences.zh: 对于你认识的那些家庭来说，看着随后的无罪释放是什么感觉？

sentences.en: There were just two more last week.
sentences.zh: 就在上周又有了两个。

sentences.en: Not guilty.
sentences.zh: 无罪。

sentences.en: That is the verdict in the trial of St. Anthony Police Officer
sentences.zh: 这就是圣安东尼警局警察杰罗尼莫·亚涅斯审判中的判决结果。

sentences.en: Jeronimo Yanez.
sentences.zh: 杰罗尼莫·亚涅斯。

sentences.en: Jurors found Yanez was reasonable in his decision to shoot and kill
sentences.zh: 陪审团裁定，亚涅斯在去年7月的一场交通拦截中，

sentences.en: Philando Castile during a traffic stop last July.
sentences.zh: 开枪打死菲兰多·卡斯蒂利亚的决定是合理的。

sentences.en: It's super hard.
sentences.zh: 这真的太难了。

sentences.en: I should say I was in the room with Michael Brown's mom when she got the news that the officer that killed her child wasn't going to be indicted.
sentences.zh: 我应该说，迈克尔·布朗的母亲得知杀死她孩子的警察不会被起诉的消息时，我当时就在房间里。

sentences.en: The lawyer took the call and as soon as she heard about it she was screaming walking through the hotel room really pacing screaming at the top of her lungs and then she ran out
sentences.zh: 律师接听了电话，她一听到这个消息就开始尖叫着在酒店房间里走来走去，真的在踱步，歇斯底里地尖叫，然后她跑了出去

sentences.en: and ran into the proteSt.
sentences.zh: 冲进了抗议人群中。

sentences.en: So that was something where I watched and it stuck with me and it still sticks with me because I think one, that she was courteous enough to allow me into that space
sentences.zh: 所以那是让我目睹并铭记在心的一幕，而且至今仍历历在目，因为第一，她那么大度，允许我进入那个如此私密的私人空间，

sentences.en: that was so private and two, that they feel as though their children have been murdered and there's no recourse and the country does not in some ways care anymore.
sentences.zh: 第二，他们觉得自己的孩子被谋杀却没有任何诉求途径，而且在某种程度上这个国家已经不再关心了。

sentences.en: Yumi Shalcinder, thanks so much for talking with us.
sentences.zh: 尤米什·阿尔辛多，非常感谢您与我们交谈。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: On Monday,
sentences.zh: 周一，

sentences.en: Philando Castile's mother reached a $3 million settlement with the city of St. Anthony, Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 菲兰多·卡斯蒂利亚的母亲与明尼苏达州圣安东尼市达成了一项300万美元的和解协议。

sentences.en: The announcement came 10 days after Officer
sentences.zh: 这一宣布是在警官杰罗尼莫·亚涅斯

sentences.en: Geronimo Yanez was acquitted of second-degree manslaughter and all other charges related to Castile's death.
sentences.zh: 因涉嫌二级过失杀人以及与卡斯蒂利亚之死相关的所有其他指控被判无罪释放10天后发布的。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday, three police officers in Chicago were charged with conspiracy and obstruction of justice in connection with the investigation that followed the death
sentences.zh: 而在周二，芝加哥的三名警察被控共谋和妨碍司法公正，这与2014年黑人青少年拉宽·麦克唐纳被警察开枪打死后的

sentences.en: of Laquan McDonald, a black teenager fatally shot by police in 2014.
sentences.zh: 调查有关。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The Trump administration is accusing Syria of preparing for another chemical weapons attack.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府指责叙利亚正在准备另一次化学武器袭击。

sentences.en: The Defense Department said it detected the preparations at the same airbase where Bashar al-Assad's regime launched a nerve gas attack in April that killed dozens of civilians.
sentences.zh: 国防部表示，其在同一空军基地探测到了准备活动，巴沙尔·阿萨德政权曾在今年4月在那里发动了一场导致数十名平民死亡的神经毒气袭击。

sentences.en: On Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 周二，

sentences.en: Syria's government denied having chemical weapons while the Trump administration threatened a heavy price for an attack.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚政府否认拥有化学武器，而特朗普政府则威胁称若发动袭击将付出沉重代价。

sentences.en: And in the latest international cyber assault, hackers have infiltrated the computer systems of corporations and government agencies across Europe and the United States,
sentences.zh: 在最新的国际网络攻击中，黑客潜入了欧洲和美国各地公司和政府机构的计算机系统，

sentences.en: including transportation, communications, and postal services.
sentences.zh: 包括交通、通信和邮政服务。

sentences.en: It's the second time in two months that hackers have hijacked data and held it for ransom using tools created by the NSA that were designed to prevent such cyber attacks.
